insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy mentions eligible room category and additional 10% co-pay for higher room, but no explicit room rent cap or type stated in wording; likely specified in Policy Schedule

icu.note: ICU charges defined but no explicit cap mentioned in wording; likely in Policy Schedule

copayment.note: Default co-payment is 50%; can be modified to 40%, 30%, or 20% at inception of first policy. Additional 10% co-pay if treated in higher room category than eligible. Co-pay cannot be changed once chosen.

sub_limits.note: Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1,00,000 per claim except total radical prostatectomy, cardiac surgeries, partial nephrectomy and surgeries for malignancies. Sub-limits do not increase with Loyalty Additions.

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible is an optional benefit; if opted, co-payment does not apply (except for higher room category). Amount not specified in wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage from policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Personal waiting periods also 24 months.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of previous year's Base Sum Insured added as Loyalty Additions each policy anniversary, up to 100% of Base Sum Insured. Sub-limits do not increase with Loyalty Additions.

restoration.display: Unlimited (ReAssure), up to Base SI per claim
restoration.note: ReAssure benefit triggered by first paid claim; provides unlimited restoration but each single claim capped at Base Sum Insured. Applies for all subsequent claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission, for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge, for the same condition.

day_care.note: Minimum 2-hour admission required; day care treatment defined as procedures under anaesthesia in less than 24 hours due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Covered if treating doctor certifies no hospital room available or patient unable to travel; minimum 3 consecutive days of treatment required.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered with minimum 24-hour admission in a qualifying AYUSH hospital. India only.

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of organ donor for harvesting covered only when insured's transplant claim is paid.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹2,000; air ambulance up to ₹2,50,000 for emergency care only. Must use registered provider. Paid only when hospital admission claim is paid.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, deep brain stimulation, etc. Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1,00,000 per claim with exceptions.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, nebuliser kit, masks, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure I. No rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatments in India only. Treatment outside India explicitly excluded under specific exclusions.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except for established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals. Pro-rata premium refunded if no claim made.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI norms with transfer of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), multifocal lens, self-inflicted injury

optional_riders.display: Annual Aggregate Deductible (optional); co-payment level selection (20%/30%/40%/50%) at inception
